working_on.feature: TTS Latency Optimization, Prewarm Preservation & ANR Prevention (P2, P1, P3, P7)
working_on.task: All 4 phases completed: Phase 01 (P2), Phase 02 (P1), Phase 03 (P3), and Phase 04 (P7).
working_on.notes: Phase 04 completed and verified with 100% passing tests (7/7 passed in QuantizationDetectionAndPrebufferTest in 54ms). Packaged assets are now recognized as INT8, target pre-buffering duration drops from 7500ms to 2000ms-2500ms, and telemetry displays true INT8 precision.

recent_changes.description: Implemented Phase 04: Robust INT8 Model Quantization Detection & Adaptive Prebuffer Optimization (P7). Enhanced detectQuantizationType with deep byte pattern detection for MatMulInteger, DynamicQuantizeLinear, and QLinearMatMul operators and directory convention checks, synchronized computeAdaptiveTargetDurationMs to select 2000ms-2500ms for INT8 rather than 7500ms FP32 fallback, and added truthful telemetry logging in TtsMetricsLogger. Verified via QuantizationDetectionAndPrebufferTest.kt (7/7 passed in 54ms).

Implemented Phase 03: Asynchronous Engine Teardown & Lifecycle ANR Elimination (P3). Added cooperative cancellation flags across decode frames and session runs in VieNeuOnnxEngine, non-blocking lock.tryLock() with background Dispatchers.IO resource teardown on engine.close(), decoupled shutdown() and reloadEngine() in VieNeuTTSManager off the Main thread, asynchronous service destruction in ReadingService, and eliminated all forced System.gc() pauses. Verified via AsynchronousEngineTeardownTest.kt (5/5 passed).

Implemented Phase 02: Cooperative Audio Pipeline Pause/Resume with Buffer Retention (P1). Introduced thread-safe PauseGate in TTSAudioPipeline, replacing destructive job cancellation and drainChannel() with cooperative suspension checkpoints, retaining up to 4 buffered chunks in audioChannel. Enhanced AudioPlayer with 100ms frame slicing and cooperative pause gate to eliminate audio repetition artifacts upon resume. Verified via CooperativePipelinePauseResumeTest.kt (6/6 passed).

Implemented Phase 01: Prewarm Preservation & Instant First-Chunk Playback (P2). Added thread-safe in-flight single-flight request coalescing (CompletableDeferred) in PrewarmedChunkCache, wrapped inference and cache deposit in withContext(NonCancellable) in VieNeuTTSManager, replaced blind cancelPrewarm with cooperative stopPrewarmAfterChunk0 coordination, added fast-path prewarmed playback (<100ms TTFT) and in-flight prewarm await in TTSAudioPipeline. Verified via PrewarmPreservationIntegrityTest.kt (5/5 passed).

errors_encountered.error: Cross-story prewarm cache retention when user initiates playback on a new story without prior prewarm
errors_encountered.solution: Added cross-story invalidation in TTSAudioPipeline.startReadingChunks, VieNeuTTSManager.speakContent, and speakWithTitlePauseInternal to evict stale story chunks when playing a different story.

decisions_made.decision: Deep byte pattern detection of quantized ONNX operators (MatMulInteger, DynamicQuantizeLinear, QLinearMatMul) in OnnxSessionManager.detectQuantizationType()
decisions_made.reason: Allows accurate recognition of dynamically quantized INT8 models even when export tools omitted metadata_props strings or path naming suffixes.

decisions_made.decision: Synchronized INT8 pre-buffer target duration of 2000ms–2500ms in TTSAudioPipeline.computeAdaptiveTargetDurationMs()
decisions_made.reason: Eliminates the 5.0s unnecessary latency caused by fallback to the 7500ms FP32 defensive buffering threshold on INT8 packaged models.

decisions_made.decision: Truthful telemetry logging in TtsMetricsLogger and formatAiDiagnosticReport
decisions_made.reason: Ensures runtime reports and metrics display the true INT8 quantization status matching actual model execution.

decisions_made.decision: Cooperative cancellation flags across decode frames and session runs in VieNeuOnnxEngine
decisions_made.reason: Allows active 3–7s inference loops to terminate within milliseconds upon cancelRequested or thread interrupt, cleanly unwinding local tensors without SIGSEGV or native crashes.

decisions_made.decision: Non-blocking tryLock and background CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO) teardown in VieNeuOnnxEngine.close()
decisions_made.reason: Eliminates Main-Thread blocking and ANR during engine destruction or precision switching. Caller returns immediately while heavy OrtSession release completes safely in background.

decisions_made.decision: Decoupled VieNeuTTSManager.shutdown() and removal of synchronous System.gc() calls
decisions_made.reason: Service onDestroy() and onTaskRemoved() complete in < 10ms, eliminating UI freezing and Android OS ANR watchdog kills.

decisions_made.decision: Cooperative PauseGate using CompletableJob in TTSAudioPipeline
decisions_made.reason: Replaced destructive pause() job cancellation and channel draining with a cooperative suspension gate checkpoint inside synthesis and playback loops, retaining up to 4 buffered audio chunks, preventing CPU waste on pause/resume.

decisions_made.decision: Sub-chunk frame slicing and cooperative pause gate in AudioPlayer
decisions_made.reason: Partitioned writeSuspended into ~100ms slices with cooperative pause checks so pause responds with sub-second precision and resume does not replay already heard audio.

decisions_made.decision: In-flight single-flight request coalescing using CompletableDeferred in PrewarmedChunkCache
decisions_made.reason: Allows playback pipeline to attach to and await an actively computing chunk 0 from prewarm without competing for the engine lock or triggering redundant duplicate inference passes.

decisions_made.decision: NonCancellable wrapping around prewarm inference, PCM processing, and PrewarmedChunkCache.put
decisions_made.reason: Guarantees that once chunk 0 inference has started, it will always finish and be deposited into cache even if the parent prewarm job receives a cancellation signal.
Replaced destructive cancelPrewarm() on play initiation with cooperative flag that lets chunk 0 complete and stops background prewarm before chunk 1, yielding engine to playback pipeline.
When chunk 0 is available in cache/in-flight, eliminates 3.5s/7.5s multi-chunk buffering wait, dropping Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) to < 100ms while synthesizing chunk 1 concurrently.
